objective_contribution: Convert Round 33 slate evidence into a causal, general terminal evidence-review primitive with guaranteed exposure and bounded token cost.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does one terminal-only review with a receipt-bound evidence slate improve fresh GLM 8K ContextBench selection when the pre-review trajectory and all other review content are shared?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Versioned terminal pause, one-call branch review, adversarial tests, fresh selection, repository preparation, preflight, freeze, live run, score, and decision.

measurement_mapping.native: Paired control and slate terminal-review outputs scored on all eight fixed identities.
measurement_mapping.retention: Slate inputs remain receipt-bound pinned-base evidence.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Both branches share exact pre-review ancestry and differ only by evidence_slate.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative model input plus output tokens for each logical path. Each branch has one call; slate is at most 1,024 measured input tokens and paired total difference at most 3,072.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Development canary cannot establish larger-window, cross-model, non-code, repair, or benchmark-wide transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: New identities absent from recorded matrices and selected before gold access.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: One frozen prefix and review per arm and identity; no reruns or replacements.

retained_counterevidence: Round 33 failed treatment exposure on three of eight pairs.
Round 33 treatment used 65,914 more logical tokens, dominated by one long continuation.
successor_rule: Pass advances to a larger fresh development replication; failure selects H58 or H0 using the complete fixed evidence.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: Reusable evidence review and token efficiency remain primary.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round 33 results and competing causal explanations lead to H57, H58, and H0.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Incomplete exposure, stochasticity, and token growth are explicit.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Quality, exposure, ancestry, calls, and paired token bounds are separately falsifiable.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: Fresh development only; no clearance claim.
criterion_verdicts.testability: One-call review and sole prompt difference can be checked exactly.
